en: The postcard features a black and white photograph showing a river with boats, buildings along the water's edge, and a large church with a tall spire and clock prominently visible in the background. Text at the bottom of the image reads 'Sundsvalls kyrka och Selångersån.' There is also handwritten text in Swedish below the image and printed address information on the back side.
